reviews.text: Luis was a valuable find for many years.  He is honest, a perfectionist and takes pride in his work, reasonable, and will be there for you if any issues with his work should arise.  Luis over the years has remodeled my kitchen, living room, bathrooms, built a deck, built a new retaining wall on my patio, and put on  a new roof.  With all these projects I was very pleased.  With all the horror stories I hear about contractors it is comforting to use one that I can trust.

Luis and his guys did tiling for two bathrooms for us. His work is beautiful. He also helped with material selection. His grout, granite for shower kerb choices were perfect, and complimented well with our tile choices. We loved his bathroom work so much that we gave him a decking job. I highly recommend him.

We had LER Home improvements come and convert are one car garage into a bedroom with full bath on main floor and redo our other full bathroom that was outdated. Luis was great , worked with us, gave us ideas and did a great job.
